name: Maine
description: Follow Maine, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Democrats poised to nominate Troy Jackson in must-win Maine Senate race
changes.summary: BANGOR, Maine — Former state Senate President Troy Jackson is on the cusp of becoming Democrats’ Senate nominee in Maine, starting a 101-day sprint to Election Day in a nationally watched, must-win race for his party.

changes.title: Democrats in Maine gather to replace Graham Platner in the race against Susan Collins
changes.summary: Democrats are hoping to move past Platner's scandal-plagued campaign as they look to unseat Republican incumbent Susan Collins. The apparent front-runner is former Maine Senate President Troy Jackson. (Image credit: Graeme Sloan).

changes.title: After Democratic Shake-Up, Susan Collins Holds Enormous Cash Edge in Maine
changes.summary: Republicans are pouring huge sums behind the Maine senator through a web of billionaire-funded super PACs. Troy Jackson, the likely Democratic nominee, has a lot of catching up to do.

changes.title: Maine Democrats meet to select Senate nominee to replace Graham Platner
changes.summary: Maine Democrats are gathering Saturday to select a Senate nominee to replace Graham Platner on the ballot, with former state Senate President Troy Jackson poised to secure the nomination.

changes.title: The Debate Moment That Captures Democrats’ Worries About Troy Jackson
changes.summary: Troy Jackson, Democratic candidate for U.S. Senate, speaks outside of a federal immigration office in Scarborough, Maine, on July 14, 2026, after a man was fatally shot by ICE agents. —Ryan Murphy—Getty Images It should have been a layup. Instead, the question illustrated why some Democrats fear they are about to swap.

changes.title: Once Anti-Abortion, Now a Progressive: The Evolution of a Maine Democrat
changes.summary: Troy Jackson, who is expected to become his party’s nominee in the state’s marquee Senate race, has long been an economic populist, but his positions on social issues have changed markedly over time.

changes.title: Democrats’ Top Senate Candidate in Maine Won’t Support Schumer for Leader
changes.summary: Troy Jackson, who is set to become the party’s nominee, also said in an interview that he was not sure he wanted the support of Senator Chuck Schumer in the general election.

changes.title: Senators demand ICE answers and body cameras after deadly shootings in Maine and Houston
changes.summary: Dozens of Democratic U.S. senators and Maine's Independent senator are demanding more details from Immigration and Customs Enforcement about vetting practices for new agents.

changes.title: 5 Things to Know About the Maine Senate Candidate Troy Jackson
changes.summary: Mr. Jackson, who has emerged as the clear front-runner to replace Graham Platner, is a Republican turned Democrat who is seen as close to Mr. Platner on policy.

changes.title: Democrats avoid a messy fight in Maine, but uncertainty lingers: From the Politics Desk
changes.summary: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.
